description:
Deep Relaxation | Release the Day | 1.5 Hours Dilruba Instrumental

Stress, emotional overwhelm, and constant mental activity can make it difficult to relax and feel at peace. This uplifting Indian instrumental music is designed to help calm the mind, ease emotional tension, and create a positive space for deep relaxation and inner balance.

Enjoy 1 hour 30 minutes of expressive Dilruba melodies blended with Santoor textures, gentle tabla rhythms, warm tanpura resonance, and soothing ambient layers.

Perfect for stress relief, anxiety reduction, meditation, yoga, focus, relaxation, studying, reading, self-care routines, and peaceful daily listening.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Dilruba, Santoor, Tabla & Tanpura
Style: Indian ambient instrumental/modern healing raga atmosphere
Mood: Uplifting, peaceful, positive, emotionally soothing
Atmosphere: Deep relaxation, stress relief, mindfulness, inner balance
Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes

🎧 HOW TO USE
Play this music while meditating, practicing yoga, working, reading, journaling, relaxing after a long day, or whenever you need a calm and positive mental space. 

For the best experience, use headphones or listen in a quiet environment. Allow the flowing Dilruba melodies to gently guide your mind toward relaxation and clarity.
